scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @sadep/contracts && npm run prisma:generate && tsc -p tsconfig.app.json
scripts.start:dev: npm run build --workspace @sadep/contracts && ts-node --transpile-only -r tsconfig-paths/register src/main.ts
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @sadep/contracts && npm run test:integration && npm run test:unit
scripts.test:integration: npm run build --workspace @sadep/contracts && node -r ts-node/register/transpile-only -r tsconfig-paths/register src/processes/tests/run.ts
scripts.bootstrap: npm run build --workspace @sadep/contracts && npm run prisma:generate && npm run db:prepare:local && npm run prisma:db:push && npm run prisma:seed && npm run db:check
scripts.prisma:generate: npm run prisma:generate:guard && prisma generate --schema prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.prisma:seed: npm run build --workspace @sadep/contracts && ts-node --transpile-only -r tsconfig-paths/register prisma/seed.ts
